主要内容: Novartis (NVS) stock gained 11% in July 2018, outperforming the S&P 500's 3.6% increase. This rally was driven by strong second-quarter earnings, with sales rising 5% on a constant currency basis due to growth in key franchises like Cosentyx and Entresto. Operating income also grew 6%, contributing to improved profitability. The company confirmed its 2018 sales and earnings forecasts, expecting revenue growth in the low- to mid-single-digit range. Novartis has several potential blockbuster treatments in development, including AveXis, with plans for additional launches in 2019 and fiscal 2020. Investors can expect modest earnings growth supported by aggressive stock repurchase activity.
